title: Act: Author item icon grids and add them to ART_SOURCES
summary: Create itemIcons.ts with six 16x16 grids and wire ITEM_SOURCES into ART_SOURCES
description: Create game/frontend/src/art/itemIcons.ts following the pattern of sceneExtras.ts (ArtSource entries built from draw.ts helpers) and spread the result into ART_SOURCES in sources.ts so the existing generator picks it up.
acceptance_criteria: itemIcons.ts exports ITEM_ICON_SIZE (16), six grid functions and ITEM_SOURCES with six entries.
sources.ts spreads ITEM_SOURCES into ART_SOURCES after SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES.
Each grid uses rampIndex colours and an indigo step 0 outline, with no hardcoded raw indices other than 0 for transparent.
technical_constraints: Shared palette only, via rampIndex from src/art/draw.ts.
definition_of_done: npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend for the new module.

steps.symbol: new: ITEM_ICON_SIZE and grid functions oldKeyGrid, noteGrid, bookGrid, coinGrid, flashlightGrid, photoGrid
steps.action: Create the file importing ArtSource from './sources' and createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, rampIndex, shadeRect, dither, Grid from './draw'. Export const ITEM_ICON_SIZE = 16 and OUTLINE = rampIndex('indigo', 0). Each function starts from createGrid(16, 16, 0) and draws a distinct silhouette: old-key (brass ramp: ring at top, shaft, two teeth), note (parchment ramp rectangle with two moon-step-2 text lines), book (plum ramp cover with parchment page edge), coin (brass ramp disc with step 5 highlight), flashlight (moon ramp body, lamp step 5 lens), photo (parchment frame with moon ramp picture and hoodie step 3 figure). Each uses outlineRect or fillRect with OUTLINE around its shape and at least two ramp steps.
steps.expected: Six functions each return a 16x16 Grid of palette indices.

steps.action: Export ITEM_SOURCES: ArtSource[] with six entries of the form { id: 'item/old-key', path: 'worlds/the-boys-room/items/old-key.png', frames: [oldKeyGrid()] } for old-key, note, book, coin, flashlight and photo.
steps.expected: ITEM_SOURCES has six entries with unique ids and paths.

steps.action: Add import { ITEM_SOURCES } from './itemIcons'; after the SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES import, and add ...ITEM_SOURCES, after ...SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES, inside the ART_SOURCES array.
steps.expected: ART_SOURCES contains the six item sources; npm run typecheck passes.
